public_rationale: The factual licensing claim is supported. AP announced an actual licensing arrangement in July 2023, and OpenAI announced a further content partnership with Axel Springer in December 2023 that included model training. Both predate the post and demonstrate awareness that licensing was possible. They do not by themselves establish deliberate dishonesty or show that comprehensive licensing was commercially feasible.
limitations: The supported grade covers the observable licensing activity and awareness.
The accusation of knowing dishonesty remains unproven.
Selected agreements do not establish that all desired training content could be licensed on workable terms.
